## Hypothesis

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class captures the edge in level-break trades with a chart-stop exit, using a VIX-trend filter to improve out-of-sample performance.

## Mechanism

The SNIPER_LEVEL_BREAK trade class uses a level-break trigger with a chart-stop exit. The VIX-trend filter is used to select trades with escalating VIX, which improves out-of-sample performance.
